test_title: PYST 13: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable replacement:
 Neither the manager nor the employees was available
solution:
The correct answer is '**were available**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb "**were**" is used when referring to a plural subject.
 
• In the given sentence, the compound subject "**Neither the manager nor the employees**" is treated as plural because "**employees**" is plural.</l
